title: eremia totta var. bartlingiana
intro: Eremia totta var. bartlingiana, commonly known as the "Mountain Rosemary" or "Goratu", is a plant species that belongs to the genus Eremia and is native to the Andes mountain range in South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Eremia totta var. bartlingiana include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in the development of new pharmaceuticals.
